related.title: U-Net 多尺度分割網路
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣；U-Net 多尺度分割網路改以收縮、擴張、跳接與像素級驗收為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling; U-Net multiscale segmentation network centers on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照clean sample與noise與影像與像素標籤，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到U-Net 多尺度分割網路，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以生成品質與失效為起點，設計一項能區分「前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣」與「收縮、擴張、跳接與像素級驗收」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare clean samples/noise with images and pixel labels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to U-Net multiscale segmentation network, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from generation quality/failures and propose an observation distinguishing forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling from contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: DDPM 擴散生成網路
history.text: DDPM 擴散生成網路的公開資料展示前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network illustrate forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
